title: How AI is expanding what people do at work
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
body: Recent economic studies suggest that artificial intelligence is shifting from a tool for simple task automation to a catalyst for role expansion in the workplace. Employees leveraging LLMs are taking on higher-level analytical, creative, and managerial tasks previously out of scope. This shift underscores the need for continuous learning programs and adaptable organizational structures to maximize AI integration. As a result, businesses are observing significant productivity boosts and a redefinition of standard career trajectories across various sectors. The report emphasizes the strategic role of human-AI collaboration.
